bug_class: B557-class promotion defect: gitignored required outputs silently omitted from promoted_paths

root_cause.defect: changed_paths() derives the promotion candidate set from `git diff --name-only HEAD` and `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard`. Git-ignored files are excluded by --exclude-standard even when they match allowed_writes and are validated by validate_required_outputs.
root_cause.missing_link: validate_required_outputs correctly found and validated the ignored required output (existence, non-empty, changed-from-baseline, allowed_writes), but its validated exact path records were never unioned into the promotion candidate set before promote().
root_cause.impact: A task with a gitignored required output (e.g., a .bin fixture) reached review_ready with the file present on disk but unpromoted to the parent repo.

repair.change: After enforce_scope and validate_required_outputs, extract exact paths from required_output_records and union into changed before calling promote(). Only already-expanded validated record paths are used, never raw glob patterns.
repair.guard_preservation: All fail-closed guards remain intact: promote() independently re-checks allowed_writes, parent-baseline hash, symlink rejection, and regular-file requirement.
